name: Media stack
description: Watch your films and series anywhere: Jellyfin plays them, Sonarr and Radarr find and sort them, Prowlarr manages the indexers, qBittorrent downloads and Jellyseerr takes requests.
notes:
All apps share Box's media folder, so downloads, the library and Jellyfin see the same files.
1. qBittorrent: sign in (Login details in the app menu) and keep the download folder /media/torrents.
2. Prowlarr: add your indexers, then Settings > Apps: add Sonarr and Radarr with their API keys (Settings > General in each app) and the server address shown in Apps.
3. Sonarr and Radarr: Settings > Download clients: add qBittorrent (this server's address and its port). Root folders: /media/data/tv and /media/data/movies.
4. Jellyfin: add the libraries /media/data/tv and /media/data/movies.
5. Jellyseerr: connect it to Jellyfin, Sonarr and Radarr.

name: Smart home
description: Home Assistant to control your devices and Node-RED to build automations with drag and drop.
notes: Home Assistant: create your account on its first page. In Node-RED, install node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket and connect it to Home Assistant with a long-lived access token (Home Assistant > your profile > Security).

name: Development
description: Gitea for your Git repositories and code-server, Visual Studio Code in the browser.
notes: Gitea: finish the setup page and create the admin account. code-server: the password is under Login details. Clone your Gitea repositories in code-server's terminal with the address shown in Apps.

name: Personal cloud
description: Nextcloud for files, calendars and contacts, Vaultwarden for passwords and Paperless-ngx for your documents.
notes: The admin user of Nextcloud and Paperless-ngx is admin; the passwords are generated (Login details in each app's menu). Vaultwarden needs HTTPS for its clients: give it a domain in its menu (Domain and HTTPS).
